Fortnite is set in contemporary Earth.
In Fortnite, a sudden appearance of a worldwide storm causes 98% of the world's population to disappear.
In Fortnite, zombie-like creatures rise to attack the remainder of the population.
Epic considers Fortnite a cross between Minecraft and Left 4 Dead.
Fortnite has up to four players cooperating on various missions.
Fortnite missions take place on randomly-generated maps.
Players collect resources in Fortnite missions.
Players build fortifications around defensive objectives.
The fortifications are meant to help fight the storm and protect survivors.
Players construct weapons and traps.
Players engage in combat with waves of the creatures.
The creatures attempt to destroy the objectives.
Players gain rewards through these missions.
Rewards let players improve their hero characters, support teams, and arsenal of weapon and trap schematics.
Upgrades let players take on more difficult missions.
Fortnite is supported through microtransactions.
Microtransactions let players purchase in-game currency.
The in-game currency can be used towards these upgrades.
Fortnite was first revealed at the 2011 Spike Video Game Awards (VGA).

Shortwave radio is radio transmission using shortwave radio frequencies.
There is no official definition of the shortwave band.
The shortwave range always includes the high frequency band (HF).
The shortwave range generally extends from 1.7 to 30 MHz (176.3 to 10.0 m).
The shortwave range extends from the high end of the medium frequency band (MF), just above the mediumwave AM broadcast band, to the end of the HF band.
Very little infrastructure is required for long-distance two-way communications using shortwave radio.
Long-distance two-way shortwave communication needs a pair of transceivers, each with an antenna.
Long-distance two-way shortwave communication needs a source of energy, such as a battery, a portable generator, or the electrical grid.
Shortwave radio is one of the most robust means of communications.
Shortwave communications can be disrupted only by interference or bad ionospheric conditions.
Modern digital transmission modes such as MFSK and Olivia are even more robust than conventional shortwave modes.
MFSK and Olivia allow successful reception of signals well below the noise floor of a conventional receiver.

The heavy showers form mainly from the interaction of two dominant airmasses in Nigeria, the Maritime tropical (south westerlies) and the Continental tropical (north easterlies).
The monsoons from the South Atlantic Ocean arrive in central Nigeria in July.

Health or vitality is an attribute assigned to entities in role-playing or video games.
Entities with health include the player character, enemies, and objects.
Health indicates an entity's state in combat.

Hit points or health points are shortened to HP.
When a player character's HP reaches zero, the player may lose a life.
When a player character's HP reaches zero, the character might become incapacitated or die.
When an enemy's HP reaches zero, the enemy may be defeated or die.
When an enemy's HP reaches zero, the player is usually rewarded in some way.
